people.name: Kedar
people.line: A son of Ishmael and a nomadic tribe

people.name: Meshech
people.line: A nation, descendant of Japheth; associated with Tubal

translations.web: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!
translations.bsb: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
translations.kjv: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!
